desc:
A frosted toasted cereal featuring limited edition jumbo rainbow marshmallow shapes in addition to Lucky's classic marshmallow hearts, stars, horseshoes, clovers, blue moons, unicorns, rainbows, and tasty red balloons

A gluten-free cereal with 12 vitamins and minerals and a good source of calcium; Enjoy a bowl of this limited edition Lucky Charms Cereal with milk as a magically delicious start to the day

Kids cereal with 19g of whole grain in every serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

Make this cereal for kids a part of an easy breakfast or gluten-free snacks for kids; A perfect pantry staple that's ready to eat or add to school snack mix recipes or homemade cereal bars; Use some as an ice cream topping

One cardboard box of crunchy Lucky Charms Cereal with Marshmallows, Limited Edition Jumbo Rainbows, Large Size, 14.9 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Delivers 19 grams of whole grain per serving to support a balanced diet.
Includes fun and iconic marshmallows like hearts, stars, clovers, moons, unicorns, and rainbows.
Formulated without wheat, barley, or rye—safe for those with gluten sensitivities.
Crunchy oat pieces coated with a light sweetness for a tasty texture balance.
Sweetened with sugar and corn syrup, but free from high-fructose corn syrup.
Includes key nutrients such as iron, vitamin D, zinc, and B vitamins.
Bright, fun packaging and charming shapes that attract young cereal lovers.

Benefits

The mix of marshmallows and crunchy oats makes mornings exciting for both kids and adults.
Packed with vitamins and minerals to help meet daily requirements in a delicious way.
A fun and flavorful cereal that’s safe for those avoiding gluten.
Combines indulgence with nutrition by delivering whole grains alongside sweet marshmallows.
Perfect straight out of the box as a dry snack or used in snack mixes and treat bars.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
